title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - BlockStorageServiceOffering
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/BlockStorageServiceOffering. A digital service available for order and offering block storage capabilities. Subclass of StorageServiceOffering per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the StorageServiceOffering model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'BlockStorageServiceOffering'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

storageConfiguration.description: Relationship. Attributes that are configurable at service instantiation. Links to a BlockStorageConfiguration entity.
